messages:
sarah_support: URGENT — customer 123 is seeing a flood of alert emails for 'high-error-rate' starting ~11:05 UTC. They say their service had zero errors in app logs. dashboard shows a huge spike in error-rate and token billing at the same time. escalation ticket: https://tickets.internal/RED-3219 :rotating_light:

mike_sre: Looking now. Is this just one org or multiple customers?

sarah_support: Only customer 123 reported it so far, but the alerts dashboard shows the threshold for the global metric 'api.errors-per-minute' firing across several orgs.

olga_prod: Can you paste the alert rule and the dashboard query? I want the aggregation window details.

sarah_support: Alert config (copied from UI):
```
rule: api.errors-per-minute > 50
metric: errors.count
aggregation: sum
window: 5m
align_to: minute
tz: UTC
```
Dashboard metric query: `GET /console/metrics?metric=errors.count&from=1769986800&to=1769990400&window=300`

tom_engineer: Quick thought — we had that recent change to metric ingestion where we apply a bucket offset for billing alignment. Could be offset applied twice (ingest + query).

mike_sre: Reproduced locally against staging metrics. When I query with window=300 I see the spike. If I change window to 60 (1m) the spike disappears and counts look normal. Seems like aggregation with 5m windows is folding partial buckets weirdly.

olga_prod: Do you have raw sample points? paste first and last points around the spike.

mike_sre: Raw points (excerpt):
```
{ts:1769990042, org:123, errors:0}
{ts:1769990061, org:123, errors:0}
{ts:1769990118, org:123, errors:0}
{ts:1769990120, org:123, errors:120}
{ts:1769990125, org:123, errors:0}
```
Looks like a single large high-count point at 1769990120 but app logs show nothing. That point correlates with a billing ingestion job that runs at 11:05 UTC.

tom_engineer: Aha — billing job writes a synthetic 'billing_events' batch into ingestion pipeline and previously we had a filter to drop non-http error metrics, but that filter got disabled in the pipeline config change last week. The billing job uses the same metric name for a brief debug counter `errors.count` (oops). The 5m window amplifies it because the single spike gets summed across the whole 5m bucket.

sarah_support: That explains customer emails. Why did only some orgs see it?

olga_prod: The billing job is sharded; only certain shards write to some orgs' streams. Also aggregation offset bug: we recently introduced a bucket offset (offset_ms = -300000) in the aggregator to align to billing boundary; that causes window alignment to shift and overlap when combined with 'align_to: minute'. If a point lands near the offset boundary it can be double-counted in two adjacent 5m buckets in our old rollup logic.

mike_sre: Repro steps I used:
1) curl -s "https://metrics.internal/query?org=123&metric=errors.count&from=1769989800&to=1769990400&window=300" > out1.json
2) inspect counts: `jq '.series[0].points' out1.json`
3) change window to 60 and re-run -> spike gone
4) toggle aggregator offset to 0 in staging config and re-run -> spike gone

tom_engineer: Fix plan:
- immediate: disable billing job writes to errors.count (rollback shard change) — @deploy_bot can you run the rollback?
- next: remove offset_ms from aggregator or make it optional per-metric (hotfix patch)
- dashboard: change alerts to use a shorter window (1m) or use `max` instead of `sum` for this metric until we fix the root cause

deploy_bot: rollback started for billing-write-shard-7 (rollback id rb-20260317-01). Will update on success. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

analytics_bot: Noted: created incident INC-20260317-7 and linked ticket RED-3219. Auto-snapshot of affected dashboards saved: https://dashboards.internal/snap/RED-3219

mike_sre: Rollback successful — billing job no longer writes to errors.count on affected shards. Observability: alerts stopped firing within one minute.

olga_prod: Pushed aggregator hotfix branch `fix/agg-offset-safe` — changes: default offset_ms=0, add per-metric override, add unit tests for boundary crossing. Will open PR now.

tom_engineer: PR created: https://repo.internal/r/redwood/ingest/pulls/1424 — requesting review from @olga_prod and @mike_sre. Also updating alert runbook to include quick-check curl commands and `window=60` fallback.

sarah_support: Customer 123 notified and support ticket updated. They acknowledged — will monitor for false alarms. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

olga_prod: Postmortem notes for follow-up (assignments):
- eng-infra: harden metric name isolation for internal jobs (tom_engineer)
- ingest: make offset opt-in and add telemetry (olga_prod)
- support: add alert template for 'unexpected single-point spikes' (sarah_support)
- monitoring: consider adding rate-limiter for synthetic internal metrics (mike_sre)

mike_sre: Closing thread when PR is merged and incident cleared.
